recommended_actions: Advise region selection closest to majority of users; recommend us-east for NA, eu-west for EU; set explicit region in API base URL
Encourage streaming responses to reduce time-to-first-byte (TTFB) and client perceived latency
Set client timeout to 30-45s for chat (avoid premature aborts at 5s); implement client-side incremental rendering
Shorten system prompts and trim historical chat window to last 6 user/assistant turns; use prefix caching on static system prompt
Limit max_tokens for completions and enforce response length budget; move heavy summarization to async jobs
Recommend using quantized lower-parameter model variant for mobile-heavy workloads; provide cost/latency tradeoff table
Enable automatic retry with exponential backoff for 5xx and gateway timeouts at client level
Share Redwood hosted region latency dashboard and a sample k6 script (Drive link) for baseline tests
